description: I reset my password from the link in the email, but my phone, which was already signed in, kept working and could still renew its login. After a reset I would expect every device to be signed out.
data_flow: resetPassword receives hash+password, sets user.password and must call SessionService.deleteByUserId({userId}) so all sessions of that user are soft-deleted before the user is updated
Without deletion the refresh-token hash stored in session rows stays valid, so SessionRelationalRepository.updateByHash still finds the row and AuthService.refreshToken keeps issuing tokens

control_flow_conditions.condition: user.password = password; /* missing: await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }); */ await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);

fix: Call sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) before updating the user in resetPassword.
notes: The invalidating call was removed from resetPassword. AuthService.update has a similar exclude-current-session invalidation for authenticated password change; that one is intact in this task.
adjudication: removed SessionRelationalRepository.deleteByUserId (padding); the resetPassword->deleteByUserId call is the removed call, recorded under missing_in_buggy_code; overlap low->medium
